topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: The air carries the scent of wood and metal, new and intrusive. My usual path through the brush is now shadowed by the looming of what they drag through the earth. The sounds, sharp and violating, cut through the quiet. This place, my place, echoes with the din of their work. They mark the land, carving out a space that whispers of boundaries and exclusion. The ground trembles, not with the gentle steps of those who walk softly, but with the force of claims and dominion. I watch, the world narrowing to the clash of intention and the space that shrinks.
